concerns.text: Task T005 introduces a 'Sample‑Size Gate' that skips any cell line with N < 4 samples. The specification (US2 & FR‑001‑FR‑010) requires training Elastic Net models for each of the five listed cell lines. This conditional skipping narrows the scope without explicit staging in the spec, constituting a weakening of functional requirements.

Task T007 states that if the percentage of top‑100 features within ±10 kb is < 80 %, the shortfall is merely noted as a finding, not a failure. Specification SC‑003 explicitly requires *at least* 80 % of top‑100 features to be within ±10 kb. Treating a shortfall as acceptable weakens the success criterion.
